description:
We are looking to hire a software professional who is a self-starter and is accustomed to working in a fast-paced environment. The right candidate must have an understanding of mobile UI Design and fluency in multiple programming languages, application development tools, experience and willingness to work in Android and iOS platforms.
 Responsibilities:
 Deliver across the entire app life cycle –concept, design, build, deploy, test, release to app stores and support
 Work with product and marketing teams to conceptualize, create new and innovative ways to improve mobile applications that can ensure excellent customer experience
 Gather requirements around functionality and translate into functional solutions
 Collaborate with UI Designers, Product engineers and QA to obtain feedback and enhance mobile applications
 Development tasks include: coding, testing, debugging, documenting, peer-reviewing, deploying, monitoring, and support
 Consistently write performance-minded, highly readable code using OO best practices
 Create compelling device specific user interfaces and experiences 3+ years developing mobile application for iOS and Android
 Successfully released apps on the App Store and Google Play (please include names of published apps)
 Excellent product and design sense with an understanding of mobile UI Design and fluency in multiple programming languages/application development tools including Java, Objective C, RESTful Services, Push Notifications, and JSON
 iOS: Experience leveraging the iOS frameworks to access native capabilities of iPhone/iPad, such as camera and location services
 Strong understanding of the Apple Human Interface Guidelines for iOS
 Strong skills in debugging any error/ crash in Xcode
 
 Android : Experience developing Android apps using Android SDK/NDK
 Strong experience in Java
 Understanding of Android security protocols
 
 Strong understanding of interactive application development paradigms, memory management, file I/O, network and socket programming, concurrency and multi-threading
 Experience working with Version Control Tools
 Experience developing in an Agile development environment
 Strong understanding and experience in Object-Oriented solution design using UML and design patterns
 
 Bachelor or Master’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field
 Knowledge of HTML5, JavaScript and jQuery
 5 years of full life-cycle and iterative development, with a good understanding of test-driven development
 Experience supporting both iOS and Android
 Entrepreneurial spirit
 Work in a fast paced environment
 Develop and update new & existing mobile solutions
 Build prototypes and proof of concepts
 Work with web developers to create and support mobile applications
 Create compelling device specific user interfaces
 Ongoing optimization to improve performance, fix design issues and bugs
 Keeping up to date on the latest industry trends in the mobile technologies
 Explain technologies and solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Contribute to task identification, and work effort estimates for development and maintenance activities
